messages:
support_alex: FYI we just got a customer report — their mobile dashboard shows chart legends that don't match the colored series. Tooltips also show values for other time ranges. They say it started after their org SSO/SCIM change yesterday. Screenshot attached.
customer_jordan: @support_alex screenshots sent in the ticket. On iPhone 12, iOS 16.4. Repro steps: open app -> Console -> Organization -> Select 'Traffic' chart -> legend items shuffled vs lines. Tapping legend highlights a different series. :angry:
support_alex: Got it. Creating internal thread. Assigned SR-9123.
support-bot: Created ticket SR-9123 and linked to workspace. :white_check_mark:
lily_prod: @devon_mobile can you reproduce on the Flutter mobile UI? Mentioned SSO but could be unrelated — possibly a race in series ordering when data arrives late.
devon_mobile: Repro'd on emulator (iPhone 12, portrait) — legend labels appear to map to series by index, not by series id. When data comes in chunks (older + new double-counted point), series ordering changes and legend uses stale mapping. Found a quick repro: toggle live updates on, then trigger an older-data sync -> legend swaps.
ashok_eng: That sounds like a front-end mapping bug. On web we bind legend items to series.id; mobile code was binding to array index (legacy). Sending snippet:

```
// mobile legend binding (buggy)
legend.item = seriesList[i].label // relies on index i
```

Should be

```
legend.item = seriesList.find(s => s.id === series.id).label
```

Also, tooltip values look wrong when the KD-tree query merges points across time buckets during re-aggregation. Possible backend delta where partial re-aggregations contain duplicate keys.
support_alex: Customer also mentioned they got a 401 earlier this morning after the SSO change. Could the auth hiccup have caused a partial metrics replay that confused the UI mapping?
sre_oncall: Checking logs for SR-9123 timeframe (2025-11-04 09:10–09:40 UTC). Saw intermittent 401s from our auth proxy around 09:12 for that org, followed by a retry from ingestion that re-submitted older datapoints. Looks like the ingestion replay didn't set stable series IDs (shard assignment changed).
ashok_eng: That fits — if the backend emitted the same metric name but assigned a new series id, mobile index-based binding would mismatch. I'll patch mobile to bind by stable series key + add guard if series id changes mid-stream.
lily_prod: Can we give customer a mitigation? Maybe pause live updates or use 'disable live merge' in console settings.
devon_mobile: Workaround: Settings -> Charts -> toggle 'Use stable series ordering' (we can expose this quickly as a feature flag). If they enable, it sorts legend by series key. I can ship a hotfix build to App Store review channel tomorrow.
support_alex: Sent workaround to customer and asked for confirmation. Also asked if they can repro on desktop — they said desktop is fine.
customer_jordan: Confirmed workaround temporarily fixes it, thanks. They are okay waiting for a proper fix but asked for ETA.
ashok_eng: Plan: (1) quick mobile patch to bind legend by series key (PR in 2h), (2) backend ingestion fix to preserve stable series IDs on retries (tracking ticket ING-701), (3) add e2e test for out-of-order chunk arrival. Est ETA: mobile patch 24–36h, backend fix 3–5 days.
support_alex: Noted. I'll update SR-9123 with the plan and estimated ETA. Also flagged billing/retention check with finance because duplicate replays could affect usage counts.
sre_oncall: Quick note — duplicate ingestion might have led to a small spike in token/metric usage for that org. I'll reconcile with billing team and send a report.
lily_prod: Thanks team. Devon — can you also include a short repro script we can attach to the internal bug? e.g., simulate delayed chunk + replay.
devon_mobile: Yep, adding steps:
1) Enable live updates in mobile app.
2) Start a metrics query with range t0..t1.
3) Inject older chunk (t-2..t0) with same metric name but new series id.
4) Observe legend label mapping swap and tooltip show value for the wrong series.

I'll paste a quick curl that simulates the replay in the bug ticket.
support_alex: Customer asked for contact if they see it again. Provided direct support contact and asked to keep the channel updated. :phone:
support-bot: SR-9123 updated: assignees -> devon_mobile, ashok_eng. Priority -> P2.
customer_jordan: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Will test the toggle over the day and post results.
ashok_eng: Pushed a small PR to mobile repo that switches legend binding to stable key, adding a defensive map. CI is green. Will request a fast-track merge.
devon_mobile: Merged to hotfix branch. Starting a build for TestFlight now. ETA to customer ~ 6h if review passes.
support_alex: Great. I'll close loop with customer once they confirm TestFlight build.
customer_jordan: TestFlight build worked — legend stable and tooltips match. Thanks everyone. :tada:
lily_prod: Marking this resolved for now. Follow-ups: ING-701 for backend replay-stability, add mobile e2e. Created follow-up tickets.
support_alex: Closing internal thread. Will reopen if customer reports again. :white_check_mark:
